top_categories.workout_context: 320 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 320 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Styrkeprøven's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
320 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
13,845ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Styrkeprøven's paved Norwegian roads from Trondheim across forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 320 miles.
Styrkeprøven's paved Norwegian roads from Trondheim across rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 13,845ft of climbing on paved Norwegian roads from Trondheim across does to your power file on race day.
At Styrkeprøven, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
13,845ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Styrkeprøven. Train it until it feels boring.
Tempo is Styrkeprøven's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 320 miles on paved Norwegian roads from Trondheim across. Train it until it's automatic.

race_overlay.heat: June in Trondheim to Oslo, Norway can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Styrkeprøven and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 320 miles requires a practiced resupply plan built around confirmed course services and available commercial stops. Rehearse frequent carbohydrate intake on long rides, then scale the plan to intensity, sleep strategy, tolerance, and real food across the full event. Carry redundant fuel and avoid applying a short-event hourly target or fixed total-calorie estimate to a multi-day race.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Styrkeprøven. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Endurance, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 320 miles of paved norwegian roads from trondheim across dovrefjell mountain plateau to oslo in Trondheim to Oslo, Norway.
